description: The three EMBER2024 subsets used in the paper, as ordered lists of sha256 hashes. Each file's features and labels come from the official EMBER2024 release named in 'source'; when the release lists a file twice, the copy with capa results is used.

balanced_capa.about: Main subset: up to 100 files from each family with at least 20 eligible files, all with capa results.

natural_capa.about: 10,000 files at random among those with capa results, keeping the real family skew.

balanced_nocapa.about: Like balanced_capa, without requiring capa results.
